targets.name: Red alarm clock
targets.notes: Ivy overlaps the left edge. The face, bells, top carry wire and right foot are included. Preview retains the original ivy context.

targets.name: White teapot
targets.notes: The lower-left body is overlapped by ivy. Complete spout, lid and knob, visible foot and the full right handle are included.

targets.name: Straw hat
targets.notes: The straw brim, crown and complete blue ribbon tails are visible. Coat hooks are context, not part of the outline.

targets.name: Purple umbrella
targets.notes: The crop includes the full wooden crook handle, closed canopy and lower black ferrule. It is intentionally a tall context crop.

targets.name: Copper watering can
targets.notes: Full back handle, cylindrical body, spout and spray rose. The two large open spaces are outlined separately as holes.

targets.name: Wooden duck
targets.notes: The lamp overlaps a small section of the tail. Full duck head and beak, breast and visible tail/body are included.

targets.name: Pink cup and saucer
targets.notes: A familiar cup-and-saucer set is one target. The full cup, handle and saucer are retained in the context preview.

targets.name: Blue-handled scissors
targets.notes: The complete two blue loops, pivot and metal blades are visible. A tight wide context crop includes the left blade tip.

targets.name: Snowflake cloth
targets.notes: Manually traced visible knitted cloth silhouette only; snowflake stitches are internal texture. The finished edit has no thumb, so the simple visible name is Snowflake cloth. The drawer overlaps its top fold.

targets.name: Blue book
targets.notes: The book remains largely exposed after the edit; its complete blue cover, rounded spine and page block are recognizable. No claim of added concealment is made for it.

targets.name: Green yarn ball
targets.notes: This target is the visible green yarn ball, not the long loose strand over the basket. Linen overlaps the rear-left fifth and the basket rim covers its bottom edge.

targets.name: Sewing machine
targets.notes: The full ordinary sewing machine replaces the much smaller thread spool as a target. Houseplant leaves and sewing fabric overlap its right edge and base. All visible identifying machine parts are retained in its preview.

review.notes: Twelve ordinary targets selected after inspecting the final image. Each was viewed in an enlarged source ROI and a final paired original-context-preview/outline sheet; root independently reviewed all twelve pairs. Full silhouettes/openings were repaired for the cloth, yarn and teapot. Modest real overlap is visible on the clock, teapot, cloth, yarn and machine; book/scissor concealment changed little. All source crops contain the entire visible identifying silhouette. This is an authored trial sample, not a claim of player acceptance or real-iPhone difficulty/performance testing.
